summary.text: Ashley Bryant Bailey is a Democratic state representative from Ohio who represents District 26 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The Ohio House Democratic Caucus appointed her to the seat on September 12, 2025, and she assumed office on October 1, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Ashley Bryant Bailey earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Cincinnati, and her career experience includes working as a senior advisor, according to Ballotpedia.
She was appointed to the Ohio House to replace Sedrick Denson (D), and she advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026, with Tom Brinkman Jr. (R) also on the general election ballot.
